formula_reference.assumption: Each occurrence of P, Q and R denotes the same event, including date bounds, quantity definitions, and substantive constraints. Different events may use different windows.

method.scope: Textual correspondence only; no real-world outcome, policy, actor, or election assessment.
method.full_body_rule: Read every body after its title. A later paragraph can restore a shortened title or premise. Missing date bounds cannot be inherited from a different standalone field.
method.reporting_rule: Omitted reporting boilerplate alone is not automatically a clear defect. An explicit change between event-time and confirmation-time bounds is substantive.

status_meanings.clear_defect: A specific cross-field event, bound, anchor, predicate, or quantity discrepancy supported by source quotations.
status_meanings.caveat: Potentially confusing wording or shared ambiguity, without a clear cross-field event-definition defect established from the full bodies.
status_meanings.no_clear_defect_found: No clear cross-field defect found in this review; not a proof of perfect semantics or a topic-eligibility decision.

method.repair_policy: Minimal repair suggestions are text only and generally copy the explicit definition already present in another field. They are not authorization to modify the source. A shared creation date must be resolved from original metadata rather than guessed.
